name: Mythic Quest
description: Journey through ancient kingdoms and discover legendary creatures from Greek mythology!

reward.name: Pegasus
reward.fact: Pegasus was a winged horse born from the blood of Medusa. The ancient Greeks believed he carried thunderbolts for Zeus.

reward.name: Hippocampus
reward.fact: The hippocampus was a sea-horse creature that pulled Poseidon's chariot across the ocean waves.

reward.name: Minotaur
reward.fact: The Minotaur lived in a giant maze called the Labyrinth on the island of Crete. The hero Theseus defeated it.

reward.name: Cerberus
reward.fact: Cerberus was a three-headed dog who guarded the entrance to the Underworld. Only Heracles ever got past him.

reward.name: Phoenix
reward.fact: The Phoenix is a magical bird that bursts into flames when it dies and is reborn from the ashes, living forever.

reward.name: Sphinx
reward.fact: The Sphinx asked travellers a famous riddle: 'What walks on four legs in the morning, two at noon, and three in the evening?' The answer is a human!

reward.name: Griffin
reward.fact: Griffins had the body of a lion and the head and wings of an eagle. They were said to guard treasure and gold.

reward.name: Owl of Athena
reward.fact: Athena was the goddess of wisdom. Her sacred animal was the owl, which is why owls are still a symbol of knowledge today.

reward.name: Sun Stag
reward.fact: Apollo rode a golden chariot that pulled the Sun across the sky every day. His sacred animals included deer and dolphins.

reward.name: Oracle Serpent
reward.fact: The Oracle at Delphi was guarded by a giant serpent called Python. People travelled for weeks to hear her prophecies.

reward.name: Bronze Bull
reward.fact: Hephaestus was the god of fire and metalwork. He built golden robots to help him in his workshop under a volcano!

reward.name: Silver Deer
reward.fact: Artemis was the goddess of the hunt and the Moon. She had a chariot pulled by four golden-horned deer.

reward.name: Winged Tortoise
reward.fact: Hermes invented the lyre by stretching strings across a tortoise shell. He was so fast he could travel between worlds in seconds!

reward.name: Styx Eel
reward.fact: The River Styx separated the world of the living from the dead. The gods swore their most sacred oaths upon its waters.

reward.name: Harvest Mouse
reward.fact: Demeter was the goddess of the harvest. When her daughter was taken to the Underworld, Demeter's sadness created winter.

reward.name: Baby Hydra
reward.fact: The Hydra had nine heads — cut one off and two more grew back! Heracles finally defeated it by burning the stumps.

reward.name: War Horse
reward.fact: Ares was the god of war. His sacred animals were the vulture and the dog, and his chariot was pulled by fire-breathing horses.

reward.name: Rainbow Parrot
reward.fact: Iris was the goddess of rainbows. She carried messages between the gods and humans by sliding down her rainbow bridge.

reward.name: Forest Faun
reward.fact: Pan was half-goat, half-human and played magical music on his pipes. The word 'panic' comes from the fear his music caused!

reward.name: Mountain Titan
reward.fact: Atlas was punished by Zeus and forced to hold up the entire sky on his shoulders for all eternity.

reward.name: Fire Hawk
reward.fact: Prometheus stole fire from the gods and gave it to humans. As punishment, an eagle ate his liver every day — but it grew back each night!

reward.name: Mechanical Owl
reward.fact: Daedalus was the greatest inventor in Greek mythology. He built wings from feathers and wax so he and his son Icarus could fly!

reward.name: Shadow Cat
reward.fact: Hades ruled the Underworld and owned a cap of invisibility. He rarely left his kingdom but was not considered evil — just stern.

reward.name: Kraken
reward.fact: Poseidon could create earthquakes by striking the ground with his trident. Sailors prayed to him before every voyage.

reward.name: Thunder Ram
reward.fact: Zeus could throw lightning bolts forged by the Cyclopes. He ruled over all the other gods from the top of Mount Olympus.

reward.name: Golden Fleece Ram
reward.fact: Jason and the Argonauts sailed across the world to find the Golden Fleece — a magical ram's skin that could heal any wound.

reward.name: Golden Ant
reward.fact: King Midas wished that everything he touched would turn to gold. He got his wish — but then he couldn't eat or drink!

reward.name: Justice Owl
reward.fact: Themis was the goddess of justice and law. She held golden scales to weigh right from wrong, and is still used as a symbol of courts today.

reward.name: Market Fox
reward.fact: Hermes was the god of merchants and trade. The ancient Greeks used silver coins called drachma — a soldier earned about 1 drachma per day.

reward.name: Fate Spider
reward.fact: The three Fates wove the destiny of every person on a magical loom. Even Zeus himself could not change what they decided!

reward.name: Nemean Lion Cub
reward.fact: Heracles had to complete 12 impossible labours. His first was to defeat the Nemean Lion whose fur no weapon could pierce!

reward.name: Voyage Dolphin
reward.fact: Odysseus took 10 years to sail home after the Trojan War, facing monsters, storms, and magic along the way!
